title: Abandoned church in Paris
summary: The abandoned church in Paris was built with a secret passage underneath the bell tower leading to the Paris Catacombs. The church could be seen from atop the Cathedral of Notre Dame.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Using hints from Joan of Arc's notes that they had retrieved in the Cave of the Gargoyle, the Huntik Foundation team found the abandoned church by spotting it from the top of the Cathedral of Notre Dame.

The church's bell tower had sunlight streaming down to the floor over the secret entrance into the Paris Catacombs. A series of mirrors would reflect sunlight at a certain angle to trigger the mechanism. Sophie Casterwill used these mirrors to reflect a Raypulse spell and opened the passage to the catacombs, while DeFoe and his Suits embushed the team. After the passage was opened, they retreated in the caverns by destroying the entrance. [Crawling the Catacombs]
